objectives.statement: Recognize and produce subordinate-clause word order, especially sentence adverbs before the finite verb.
Choose written subordination linkers such as at, dersom, selv om, and som for the intended relation.
Build precise relative clauses with som, including negative clauses such as som ikke kommer.
Read and construct denser written sentences with nested subordinate clauses without losing the main-clause structure.

notes: Late-B2 written-syntax capstone. Must teach denser written subordinate clauses in modern Bokmål, including nested clauses and sentence-adverb-before-finite-verb order in subordinate clauses, without implying ceremonial formal speech or drifting into literary/archaic style.
